//: COMPOSITE (tree) fixture — CONTEXT-COUPLED SEAM. Where button-group/badge-group/list composites nest CONTEXT-FREE children (the parent passes the child nothing), this one probes the harder case: a seam where the parent decides a child's STATE — here which tab is `--active`. The oracle golden is the core snippet shape from snippets/tabs.html: a `<div class="pa-tabs">` wrapping bare `<button class="pa-tabs__item [pa-tabs__item--active]">` children — NO id, NO data-*, NO switching wiring. That is the class contract the CSS blesses. svelte's <TabItem> matches it as-is (active is an explicit `active` prop; the button is class-only). keen's tab_item/1 additionally bakes LiveView server-switching into the SSR markup — `id="tab-btn-{target}"`, `data-tab-target="{target}"`, and `phx-click={switch_tab(...)}` — the id/data siblings of phx-click, DOM handles switch_tab needs to find the button. phx-click is dropped by the wrapper-wide defaults (phx-* = noise); the `id` + `data-tab-target` handles are keen-tab_item-SPECIFIC, so they are trimmed via this fixture's PER-COMPONENT `normalize` block rather than the global normalizer (a different component legitimately using that id prefix / data attr stays checked). With those handles trimmed as wiring, BOTH wrappers compare clean against the class contract the CSS actually cares about. NOTE the container-only tabs.json fixture HID the item markup entirely (its body slot is plain text — no items ever render); this composite is what makes the item markup flow through the seam. check-all.mjs SKIPS composites, so this does not gate CI; run it with compare.mjs per wrapper.

normalize.//: PER-COMPONENT wiring trims (merged onto the wrapper-wide phx-*/data-phx* defaults). keen tab_item's switch_tab handles — invisible to CSS, not in the oracle's bare-button contract. Scoped to this fixture so the global normalizer stays blind only here, not everywhere.

goldenConventions: Golden = the core snippet shape: `.pa-tabs` div wrapping bare `.pa-tabs__item` buttons, exactly one carrying `--active`. No id / data-* / switching attrs — those are per-wrapper interactivity, not the class contract. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace normalized away. keen's phx-click is dropped by the wrapper-wide defaults; its id="tab-btn-*" + data-tab-target are dropped by this fixture's per-component `normalize` block (see the top note).

features.//: PARENT (tabs) feature vocabulary — exercised subset. The full pa-tabs--* modifier contract is asserted by tabs.json; this fixture is about the item seam, not the container's class contract (check-all skips composites).
